title: Layer 3 round 4 minor: the vsdd init/preflight command surface prints cwd, tool versions, and init errors outside the shared cleaner — a Layer 4 (Install) surface carry, not a Layer 3 status surface

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 800878a5 as a DECLARED scope boundary: the text.rs module doc now states the shared policy covers the STATUS surfaces (segment, human, machine, broken-state) and the registry strings they consume; the vsdd init/preflight command surface (cwd, on-PATH tool versions, init-error paths) is Layer 4's (Install) and routes its own operator-local strings through the same helper when Layer 4 hardens. The content there is operator-environment (the same trust boundary as the PATH posture), not adopter/state data; the cleaner is available and the wiring is Layer 4's act. Recorded so the asymmetry is a deliberate decision, not a silent gap — the finding's own preferred disposition.
